title: ID0441698-DC/Si-D/CH-[RVP/T6170004833] Anomaly noted
description:
Reported behavior/issue: Upon successful commissioning, an anomaly was noted in the
charger's converter grouping behavior. While charging on DC1
yields a maximum of 80 kW (with 2 converters in the group),
charging on DC2 is restricted to 40 kW, even though it also utilizes
2 converters.
